lazy.dialogue.chat: A chat works. It's the one chore you can do sitting down.
lazy.dialogue.chat/1: A chat's the one chore you can do lying down. So — go on, %1$s.
lazy.dialogue.chat/2: Sure, talk. It pairs nicely with sitting, which I was already committed to.
lazy.dialogue.conversations: Talking? Fine. Sit down first, %1$s — standing conversations always run long.
lazy.dialogue.conversations/1: Sure, let's talk. Pull up something to lean on first. No sense standing through it, %1$s.
lazy.dialogue.conversations/2: Talk away. I was going to do nothing anyway — might as well do it with company.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: Been good. Slept in, skipped a chore, the world kept turning. Suspicious how well that works.
Good. Did the bare minimum and the sky didn't fall. Vindicating, honestly.
Comfortable. That's my version of thriving. Warm patch, full belly, no one needing me.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.roug: Rough, honestly. Even my naps have been tired lately, %1$s. That's how I know.
Off, lately. Even resting's been hard work, which is the worst news a man like me can get, %1$s.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.agai: You asked already. I haven't moved, and neither has the answer. Restful, isn't it?
Twice now? That's more effort than I've spent all morning. Still fine. Still sitting.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.day.good: Found the sunny patch by the well and stayed in it. The day arranged itself around me.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Claimed the sunny spot by the well early and defended it all day. A triumph, in its way.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough: Someone expected things of me before noon. The day never recovered.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: Somebody wanted something before I'd finished waking up. Ruined the whole schedule of nothing I'd planned.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.work.like: I like the parts between the parts. The leaning, the waiting. Done right, that's most of the job.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.work.like/1: I like the pauses. The lean, the stretch, the long look at the horizon. That's the good part, and I'm expert at it.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.work.hate: The work's fine. It's the doing of it. Every chore would improve with a hammock nearby.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.work.hate/1: The work's fine in theory. It's the lifting and the doing. Everything's better within reach of a chair.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.village.home: %2$s? Good sunny spots, gentle hills, a well close enough that fetching water's almost restful. Ideal, really.
I've napped in every corner of %2$s, %1$s. That's how you truly know a place — where the best shade falls.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.people.first: Good folk. They do the bustling so I don't have to. Lovely arrangement. I supervise from the fence.
Nice neighbors. Half of them think I'm asleep and say the interesting things nearby. Best gossip in the village, and I never move.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.food.first: Anything I don't have to chase, catch, or cook. A pie someone else made, ideally, brought to where I'm sitting.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.food.first/1: Bread within arm's reach. The whole trick to eating well is not having to get up for it, %1$s.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.life.first: My whole life, %1$s? That's a lot of sitting to tell. Luckily I was sitting for most of it. Get comfortable.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.life.first/1: A long, comfortable sit of a life, %1$s. Not much walking in it. Settle in, I'll get to the good parts eventually.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: A porch facing the sunset, so the day ends where I'm already sitting. Perfect dream. No walking in it at all.
A porch, a sunset, and nothing on the far side of the fence asking for me. That's the whole dream. Perfect as is.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.fears.first: That I'll doze through the one day that actually mattered. I don't sleep as easy as folks think.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.fears.first/: Sleeping through the one day that counted. People think I rest easy. I don't, quite, %1$s.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.feelings.fir: You're the one visit I don't need a nap to recover from, %1$s. From me, that's poetry.
You're the one visit worth sitting up for. Don't let it swell your head — I still won't be standing.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.deflect.pers: That question needs sitting up straight for, and I barely know you. Come back — I'll save you a spot on the fence.
That's a sit-up-straight kind of question, and I've only just met you. Come back — the fence has room.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.deflect.inti: Some things I only say lying in the grass with someone I trust. We're not that far along. Yet.
Those I save for lying in the grass with someone I trust. We'll get there. No rush. Never a rush, %1$s.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: News takes effort to happen, and nobody's bothered. My kind of week.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.none/: Nothing. News is effort, and nobody could be bothered. Suits me down to the ground.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes: Happy? You're the one thing worth getting up for, %1$s — and I still usually don't have to. That's the dream.
With you, doing nothing finally feels like doing everything. Best deal I ever lazed into. Yes.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.marri: %2$s and %3$s got hitched. Nice do, apparently. I heard it from the fence without getting up. Efficient.
Word is %2$s married %3$s. Good for them. Weddings are a lot of standing, so I'm glad it wasn't mine.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.divor: %2$s and %3$s called it quits. Shame. Splitting up sounds like even more work than staying together, if you ask me.
%2$s and %3$s aren't a pair anymore. I won't take sides — takes too much energy to hold an opinion that firm.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.death: %2$s passed, %1$s. ...Sorry. Even I sat up straight for that one. Rest easy, wherever the easy chairs are.
We lost %2$s. Quiet loss. I've been sitting with it most of the afternoon, which is about all I can do.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth: %2$s had a baby. New little one in the village. All that crying — glad the napping's their job now, not mine.
There's a new baby over at %2$s's place. Sweet little thing. Sleeps all day, which is frankly the dream, %1$s.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.arriv: %2$s moved in. New neighbor. I'll get around to waving eventually — no rush, they only just got here.
Somebody new turned up — %2$s. Seems fine. I'll form a full opinion after a nap or two, %1$s.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.depar: %2$s packed up and left the village. All that hauling and loading. Just thinking about it makes me want to lie down.
%2$s moved away for good. Bit of a shame. That was a good fence to lean on near their place, too.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.confused: Hm? That sounded like effort. Say it simpler.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: *yawns* Didn't catch it. Or try to, honestly.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.hint: Could ask me about %2$s. If you insist on talking.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.hint/1: %2$s… pick whichever needs the least explaining.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.shrug: Dunno. Sounds like a tomorrow problem.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.clarify: %2$s or %3$s… you pick. Deciding is work.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.busy/1: In a bit. The bench and I have an arrangement.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.muted: Best request I've had all week.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.muted/1: *gives a thumbs up and settles deeper*
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.farewell: Mm. Bye, %1$s. Don't rush back on my account.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.insult: Can't be bothered to mind. Lucky you.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.hail: Oh. Hey, %1$s. You're just in time for nothing much.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.hail/1: Mm? Oh, hello. Pull up some shade.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.hail_cold/1: Ugh. Standing up for this? No.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.attentive: Mm? Talking, is it. Alright, go.
